title: Finite type locally constant module sheaf on a small site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and $B$ a commutative ring. Put $\underline B$ equal to the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. A sheaf $F$ of $\underline B$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is locally constant of finite type if for every object $U$ there is a covering sieve $S$ such that for every $V\to U$ in $S$ there is a finitely generated $B$-module $M$ [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and an isomorphism $F|_V\simeq\underline M|_V$ of module sheaves on $\mathcal C/V$. Here $\underline M$ is the existing constant module sheafification functor of [def-weil-pbc-strict-perfect-coefficient-package]. No points or terminal object are required.
